# Requirements Quality Gate Checklist: City Waste Collection Tracking Platform

**Purpose**: Formal-gate "unit tests for the requirements" — validates completeness, clarity,
consistency, measurability, and coverage of the spec before `/speckit-tasks`. Author-facing,
pre-tasks. Emphasis: realtime tracking, security & privacy, geo/admin workflows, plus an even
sweep of the remaining areas.
**Created**: 2026-07-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness — Realtime Tracking

- [x] CHK001 Is "the auto currently serving the resident's route" defined when multiple autos run the same route simultaneously — which auto(s) does the resident see? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-RES-01, FR-FLEET-02]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for how a "collected" event / "last-collected timestamp" is determined for a household (proximity-derived? trip completion? driver action?)? [Gap, Spec FR-RES-02]
- [x] CHK003 Is behavior specified for offline gaps longer than the 5-ping batch — are older pings dropped, spooled, or is the trip trail allowed to have holes? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-DRV-03 vs NFR-07]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for a trip interrupted by app kill/device death — resume vs forced end, and who may abort a trip (driver only? admin?)? [Gap, Spec FR-DRV-08, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Is the behavior of the resident live map defined when no trip is active (empty state, "next collection" hint)? [Gap, Spec FR-RES-01]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements specified for what happens to an active trip when its auto or driver is reassigned mid-day? [Gap, Spec FR-FLEET-04/05, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for missed or skipped passes (pass 1 never starts — can pass 2 run? how is the day closed out)? [Gap, Spec FR-DRV-02, FR-ROUTE-02]
- [x] CHK008 Is the position-noise rejection rule's user-facing consequence specified (driver feedback when pings are rejected; trail continuity)? [Gap, Spec §4 integrity rules]

## Requirement Completeness — Security & Privacy

- [x] CHK009 Are driver consent requirements specified (consent to trip-time tracking, what the driver is told, withdrawal path) as DPDP requires? [Gap, Spec NFR-04/NFR-06]
- [x] CHK010 Is the user data-deletion requirement (NFR-04) expressed as a functional flow — who can request, what is deleted vs anonymized (trips, pings, complaints), within what SLA? [Gap, Spec NFR-04]
- [x] CHK011 Are account-linking edge requirements defined for Google sign-in (Google account already linked to another phone; email collision)? [Gap, Spec FR-AUTH-03]
- [x] CHK012 Are session/credential requirements defined for concurrent logins (same driver on two devices; resident on multiple devices)? [Gap, Spec FR-AUTH-04/06]
- [x] CHK013 Are API abuse/rate-limit requirements specified beyond OTP (e.g., complaint spam, presign abuse, WS reconnect storms)? [Gap, Spec FR-AUTH-02 only covers OTP]
- [x] CHK014 Is the audit-log requirement measurable — which admin mutations, which fields, retention period, who can read it? [Clarity, Spec NFR-05]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for media privacy — retention and access control of driver photos and complaint photos (NFR-06 covers only pings)? [Gap, Spec FR-DRV-06, FR-CMP-01, NFR-06]
- [x] CHK016 Is Ward Admin offboarding specified (account disable, ward reassignment, effect on open complaints/review queues)? [Gap, Spec FR-WARD-06]

## Requirement Completeness — Geo & Admin Workflows

- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for editing a ward boundary after households/routes exist (re-mapping trigger, admin confirmation, notification to affected residents)? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases mention it without an FR]
- [x] CHK018 Is atomicity specified for bulk boundary import (partial failure: all-or-nothing vs per-feature accept/reject, and how rejects are reported)? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-WARD-04]
- [x] CHK019 Are route serviceable-area overlap rules within the same ward defined (may two routes overlap? which route wins household mapping)? [Gap, Spec FR-ROUTE-01, FR-AUTH-08]
- [x] CHK020 Is the review-queue workflow complete — SLA/aging, resident-visible status, what the resident sees and can do while pending? [Coverage, Spec FR-AUTH-08]
- [x] CHK021 Are operator lifecycle requirements complete (retiring an operator that still owns active wards; transferring wards between operators)? [Gap, Spec FR-WARD-01]
- [x] CHK022 Are auto/driver deactivation rules specified when they hold an active assignment or active trip (maintenance/retired transitions)? [Gap, Spec FR-FLEET-01/03]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK023 Is "updated ≤ every 2 s with client-side marker interpolation" testable as written — is the 2 s bound on server emit, client render, or end-to-end? [Clarity, Spec FR-RES-01 vs SC-004]
- [x] CHK024 Is "large-touch, glove-friendly" quantified (minimum touch-target size, contrast) or is it subjective? [Measurability, Spec FR-DRV-02]
- [x] CHK025 Is "tracking dropped" precisely defined (measured from received_at vs recorded_at; alert clearing conditions when pings resume)? [Clarity, Spec FR-DRV-05]
- [x] CHK026 Are the notification examples normative or illustrative ("Auto is ~300 m away · Today: Wet + Dry") — is exact copy, localization, and distance rounding specified? [Clarity, Spec FR-NOTIF-01]
- [x] CHK027 Is "99.5% availability during collection hours" measurable — measurement window (monthly?), what counts as "down", which components are in scope? [Measurability, Spec NFR-02]
- [x] CHK028 Is the "pilot device matrix" referenced by SC-007 defined anywhere (device list, OEM/OS coverage)? [Gap, Spec SC-007, Risks]
- [x] CHK029 Is "multi-city ready" specified with concrete requirements (city entity, per-city admin scoping, tile coverage) or is it aspirational? [Ambiguity, Spec title/Assumptions]
- [x] CHK030 Are timezone assumptions explicit (IST fixed? collection windows and "collection day" boundaries for ratings defined in which timezone)? [Gap, Spec FR-CMP-05, NFR-02]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK031 Do FR-NOTIF-02 ("one alert per household per trip") and multi-auto routes stay consistent — with two autos on one pass, can a household receive two alerts (one per trip)? [Conflict, Spec FR-NOTIF-02, FR-FLEET-02]
- [x] CHK032 Are FR-AUTH-06 (15-min access tokens) and long-lived resident WebSocket sessions reconciled (mid-stream token expiry: drop, re-auth, or grace)? [Conflict, Spec FR-AUTH-06, contracts/realtime.md §2]
- [x] CHK033 Is FR-DRV-08 (auto-end after 30 min idle "after a driver confirmation prompt") consistent with an unreachable/dead device that cannot show a prompt? [Conflict, Spec FR-DRV-08, FR-DRV-05]
- [x] CHK034 Are FR-RES-07 (no driver PII to residents) and complaint categories ("behavior") consistent — can a behavior complaint be filed and processed without exposing driver identity to the resident? [Consistency, Spec FR-RES-07, FR-CMP-01]
- [x] CHK035 Is the rating trigger (FR-CMP-06, v1.1) consistent with FR-CMP-05 being MVP — what triggers the MVP rating opportunity if the prompt mechanism ships later? [Conflict, Spec FR-CMP-05/06 priorities]
- [x] CHK036 Do spec §4 (pings rejected > 60 km/h) and urban highway stretches coexist — is a legitimate 60+ km/h transit between route segments impossible by definition? [Assumption, Spec §4 integrity rules]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK037 Are zero-state requirements defined across surfaces (ward with no routes, route with no households, resident in unmapped city area, driver with no assignment)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK038 Are recovery requirements defined for backend/broker outage during active trips (driver behavior, data loss bounds, resident messaging)? [Gap, Recovery]
- [x] CHK039 Are requirements defined for FCM unavailability or notification-permission-denied residents (in-app fallback? silent degradation?)? [Gap, Spec FR-NOTIF-01]
- [x] CHK040 Is behavior specified when a resident's household pin is moved while a trip is active on their old route (live map, pending alerts)? [Edge Case, Spec FR-RES-04]
- [x] CHK041 Are DST-free but calendar-edge cases covered (route schedule on public holidays; "collection days" skipping)? [Gap, Spec FR-ROUTE-01]
- [x] CHK042 Are requirements defined for duplicate or out-of-order ping delivery (QoS 1 redelivery) affecting distance, trails, and geofence triggers? [Coverage, contracts/realtime.md §1]

## Non-Functional Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK043 Are graceful-degradation requirements specified beyond peak targets (behavior at >100k concurrent sessions: load shedding order, which features degrade first)? [Gap, Spec NFR-01/SC-006]
- [x] CHK044 Are accessibility requirements defined at all (they are currently absent for both apps and the portal)? [Gap]
- [x] CHK045 Is localization scope precise — which surfaces are EN+KN (resident app, driver app "Kannada-first" per Risks, admin portal?) and what is the fallback for untranslated strings? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-RES-06, Risks]
- [x] CHK046 Are observability requirements tied to the SLOs (is the per-ward tracking-health dashboard's content/thresholds specified)? [Clarity, Spec NFR-09, NFR-03]
- [x] CHK047 Are storage/cost bounds specified for media (per-trip photo caps, total retention for proof photos)? [Gap, Spec FR-DRV-06]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK048 Is the assumption that official BBMP boundary files are obtainable validated with a fallback requirement for pilot (hand-drawn boundaries acceptable at what fidelity)? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions §12-5]
- [x] CHK049 Are SMS provider failure requirements defined (DLT registration delayed at launch, provider outage during registration spikes)? [Assumption, Spec Risks, FR-AUTH-02]
- [x] CHK050 Is the dependency on Google Sign-In availability documented with a phone+password-only fallback requirement? [Dependency, Spec FR-AUTH-03]
- [x] CHK051 Is the assumption "one household per resident user" (D-3) reconciled with shared phones/families (two residents, one device; one resident, two houses)? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions D-3]
